dimensions.assessment: Affects agricultural producers of high-value crops (including citrus) nationwide who experience qualifying losses.
dimensions.evidence: make payments to producers of high value crops (including citrus) for losses of revenue or losses of quality or production

dimensions.assessment: Provides direct financial relief payments or block grants to agricultural producers affected by specific natural disaster events.
dimensions.evidence: carrying out a program to make payments to producers of high value crops... as a consequence of a drought, wildfire, hurricane, flood, etc.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes federal financial assistance and block grants for agricultural losses, though specific funding amounts are not stated in the text.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may carry out a program to make payments... [through] block grants to States and territories.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Agricultural Act of 2014 to add a specific new emergency assistance program for high-value crop losses.
dimensions.evidence: Subtitle E of the Agricultural Act of 2014 (7 U.S.C. 9081 et seq.) is amended by adding at the end the following

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory authorization for ongoing or event-triggered emergency assistance.
dimensions.evidence: is amended by adding at the end the following: SEC. 1502. EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE FOR HIGH VALUE CROP LOSSES.

missing_information: No specific funding level or appropriation amount is stated in the bill text.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes the USDA to provide emergency payments and block grants to producers of high-value crops for revenue, quality, or production losses caused by extreme weather and other specified events.
